comments.body: I've passed an `isPlural` to handle this kind of logic in the template (Mustache can't check if a variable is of a specific value, it can only check truthy/falsy)

Hmm ok, so `hasZeroResults`, `hasOneResult` and `hasManyResults`. Will populate those fields with the english logic at first and we'll handle languages that have different definition of "many" (3+, 4+) later on.
